title.narrative: UNHCR, assist Eriterean & S.Sudanes refugees UNHCR

description.narrative: This project with the United Nations High Commission for Refugees (UNHCR) strengthens core protection and assistance activities (child protection, birth registration, prevention and response to GBV and support to persons with specific needs) targeting vulnerable refugees in Addis Ababa and Gambella.Activities include 1/ Enhancing the protective environment for refugee children;2/ Reducing risks of GBV and improve quality of response; 3/ Strengthening mental health and psychosocial support services 4/ Increasing individual registration and documentation. 5/ Providing one-time cash-assistance to self-relocated (from Tigray) Eritrean refugees in Addis Ababa.
